headline: 175mm rain in 24 hours: Dhaka sinks as monsoon intensifies
summary: Record rainfall has left the capital waterlogged, disrupting transport, closing educational institutions, and stranding passengers at the airport.
details: Dhaka recorded a seasonal record of 175mm of rainfall within 24 hours, leading to severe waterlogging across the city. Major roads have been submerged, causing extreme hardship for residents and commuters.

The heavy rains have severely disrupted transport, with some commuters reporting that a 3.4 km journey took as long as 90 minutes. Passengers were also stranded at Dhaka airport due to flooded access roads.
Educational institutions have been hit hard, with Dhaka University campus being flooded. This led to the suspension of all exams on Monday and the disruption of classes.

In student halls at Dhaka University, electricity supplies were cut off in two female halls due to the waterlogging. Traders in local markets are also scrambling to save their goods from the rising water.
The weather forecast predicts continued heavy rainfall in Dhaka and Chittagong, with warnings of thunderstorms and wind speeds up to 60 km/h in 20 districts, including the capital.

headline_marked: Former acting president [[Jamiruddin Sircar laid to rest]] at Parliament graveyard
headline: Former acting president Jamiruddin Sircar laid to rest at Parliament graveyard
summary: The 94-year-old former Speaker and acting president was buried on the parliament premises after a second funeral prayer.
details: Former Speaker and acting president Barrister Jamiruddin Sircar passed away on Sunday morning at a private hospital in Dhaka at the age of 94.
His second funeral prayer was held on Sunday afternoon at the south plaza entrance of the National Parliament building.

The prayer was attended by high-profile figures including Prime Minister Tareq Rahman, Opposition Leader Dr. Shafiqur Rahman, Speaker Major (Retd) Hafiz Uddin Ahmed, and Home Minister Salahuddin Ahmed.
Other attendees included members of the cabinet and parliamentarians from both the government and opposition parties.
During brief speeches before the prayer, Local Government Minister Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir and Jamaat-e-Islami Amir Dr. Shafiqur Rahman shared memories of the late politician's long career.
The Speaker of the National Parliament noted that Barrister Jamiruddin Sircar was a man about whom no one had any complaints.
Following the funeral prayer, he was buried in the graveyard adjacent to the parliament premises.
caption:
A statesman's final journey. Former acting president Jamiruddin Sircar has been laid to rest at the parliament graveyard.

Former Speaker and acting president Barrister Jamiruddin Sircar passed away on Sunday morning at a private hospital in Dhaka at the age of 94.

His second funeral prayer was held on Sunday afternoon at the south plaza entrance of the National Parliament building.

The prayer was attended by high-profile figures including Prime Minister Tareq Rahman, Opposition Leader Dr. Shafiqur Rahman, Speaker Major (Retd) Hafiz Uddin Ahmed, and Home Minister Salahuddin Ahmed.

Other attendees included members of the cabinet and parliamentarians from both the government and opposition parties.

During brief speeches before the prayer, Local Government Minister Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir and Jamaat-e-Islami Amir Dr. Shafiqur Rahman shared memories of the late politician's long career.

The Speaker of the National Parliament noted that Barrister Jamiruddin Sircar was a man about whom no one had any complaints.

Following the funeral prayer, he was buried in the graveyard adjacent to the parliament premises.
